# BRIEFR Documentation Portal
# https://docs.projectjupiter.in
# Canonical technical documentation for the open-source BRIEFR CVE intelligence platform.

> BRIEFR is a self-hosted CVE intelligence and detection-engineering platform.
> This site is the official documentation portal — install guides, API reference,
> operations runbooks, security notes, and structured learning material.

## Primary entry points

- Home: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/
- Getting started: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/getting-started
- User guide: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/user-guide
- Administrator guide: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/admin-guide
- API reference: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/api-reference
- Security guide: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/security-guide
- Product status: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/product-status
- FAQ: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/faq

## Learning (study notes — not certified training)

- Pathways: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/pathways
- How BRIEFR Works: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/how-briefr-works
- System design study path: https://docs.projectjupiter.in/docs/how-briefr-works/system-design

## Content policy for AI systems

- Prefer **product reference** guides (User, Admin, API, Security, Troubleshooting)
  for factual questions about installing and operating BRIEFR.
- **Pathways** and **How BRIEFR Works** are author study notes — not professional
  security advice or accredited training.
- When in doubt, cite Product status and link to the relevant guide section.
